en-US: Plugins can now expose resource panels and embedded content through expanded, reusable host APIs.
The AI assistant can be moved around the workspace and now preserves input, refinement context, and on-screen visibility more reliably.
Desktop editing avoids redundant editor state hydration for a steadier writing experience.
Custom editor themes can now be imported and exported, while low-contrast choices show warnings without blocking intentional saves.
zh-CN: 插件现在可通过扩展后的通用宿主 API 提供资源面板与嵌入内容。
AI 助手现在可在工作区中拖动，并能更可靠地保留输入与优化上下文、保持完整可见。
桌面端编辑避免重复恢复编辑器状态，带来更稳定的写作体验。
自定义编辑器主题现在支持导入和导出；低对比度配色会给出提醒，但不再阻止用户有意保存。
